notes:
Fullobby 0.4.0

Onboarding no longer traps users or punishes them for losing a session.

- The first-run wizard has a way back out. Picking the wrong identity at the
  sign-in step used to be unrecoverable: the overlay covers the whole shell,
  including Settings and Sign Out, and the steps only went forward. An admin
  whose client had lost its session would sign in as someone new, reach the
  link step, be told their Discord belongs to a different user, and have no
  route back.
- A refused provider link now offers the sign-in that resolves it, instead of a
  toast that says (literally) "Forbidden".
- Losing a session asks for a sign-in rather than replaying all five onboarding
  steps. Credentials go away for ordinary reasons; none of them mean the setup
  is gone.
- An undecryptable stored secret is treated as absent rather than handed back
  as ciphertext, which used to cost the user their entire setup silently.
- The limited-beta network gate is a banner over the app, not a wall in front
  of it. Seeding stays blocked; the rest of the app stays reachable.

Requires the API changes in fullobby-api#20 for the refused-link message.
